native_macos_mlx.shared: f16 X and W, BK padded from 32 to 40 (5120 bytes total)
native_macos_mlx.inner_schedule: load two A and two B 8x8 fragments, then four back-to-back MMAs for each of four ascending k slices
native_macos_mlx.barriers: two threadgroup barriers per BK32 plus BlockMMA simdgroup memory-none barriers

main_a4118f8.shared: f32 X and W, unpadded 4096 bytes
main_a4118f8.inner_schedule: two ascending k slices with eight MMAs each
main_a4118f8.isa: 699 static instructions, 445 ALU/fscib, 404 IC, 99 GPRs, 1024 resident threads, dual-pipeline balance 0.9539

differences_exercised: candidate-v1 copied native four-subgroup/BK32 geometry while retaining f32 shared operands required by cooperative_matrix_f32_8
candidate-v2 isolated four-subgroup accumulator ownership at BK16 and restored the 4 KiB shared footprint
candidate-v3 retained the main two-subgroup schedule but copied native 80-byte padding and transposed/column-major weight staging

double_buffering.reason: Native qmm_t_impl is single-buffered. Honeykrisp exposes no async shared copy here, so the same lanes cannot overlap the next global load/dequantization with current MMA work; double buffering would only double f32 shared residency.

final_runtime_tree: identical to a4118f8744dc48f8f12634985d3d3548c032cc44 for primitives.cpp, qmm_coopmat.comp, and qmm_tile.comp

candidate-v3.design: two subgroups, BK16, native 80-byte padded and column-major weight staging

shape_conditional_dispatch.estimated_model_impact: about 1%; not implemented because it needs a second local-size/pipeline variant and does not close the wide-projection bound

conclusion: On Honeykrisp, main's 32x32 tile with two 16x32 fragment assignments beats every native-like alternative on all three wide projection shapes. The 1113 versus 1838 tok/s gap at 1053 tokens is not the tile schedule.

paired_fork.reason: No candidate met the required 1.10 kernel speed ratio across the eight screened shapes.

paired_stock.reason: Paired six-leg runs are prohibited before a candidate clears the kernel screen.

digests.reason: No candidate advanced to paired model qualification; final runtime sources were reverted byte-for-byte to a4118f8.

tests.m1_candidate_builds: All three diagnostic wheels compiled and loaded with cooperative_matrix_f32_8=1; see candidate-v*/build.log and identity.log.
tests.kernel_profiles: Each variant ran 8 discarded warmups and 16 recorded valid-input samples for all four Qwen projection shapes at m=262 and m=1053.
tests.local_shader_compile: Unavailable: local glslangValidator 12.0.0 rejects GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix; M1 builds used the pinned glslang toolchain.
tests.targeted_cpp: Not retained because no candidate survived the mandatory kernel screen; a partially started rejected-candidate run was stopped and removed.

decision: reject all three native-schedule candidates, preserve the measured narrow-KV option, and keep main runtime sources
